summary: Top 20 video topics for the Stikaman channel ranked by a weighted composite score of keyword competition (lower = better, 40% weight), proven breakout multiplier from small channels (higher = better, 35% weight), and recency/trending signal (25% weight). Each topic includes the specific evidence: which small channel broke out, their sub count at the time, how many views they got, the breakout multiplier, and the keyword competition score.
